item.title: Want to turn Apple's iPhone Duo into a mini laptop? New keyboard case adds trackpad and MagSafe support
item.description: Nøord has unveiled a $249 keyboard case for Apple's iPhone Duo, featuring a built-in trackpad, five-row keyboard and MagSafe connectivity to create a mini laptop-like setup. Available in Black, White and Titanium, the accessory is expected to start shipping in January 2027.

item.title: Samsung brings Galaxy Watch 9's health features to Galaxy Watch 8: Check all new One UI 9 additions
item.description: Samsung is rolling out the One UI 9 Watch update for the Galaxy Watch 8 and Watch 8 Classic, adding Heart Health Score, Vitals, Daily Cardio Load and upgraded Sleep Apnea monitoring. The update also brings personalised Sleep Coaching, improved fitness tracking and new navigation features.
